verdict.rationale: A desktop app is a fair question for an authenticator, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only mobile apps ("several mobile platforms", Android gestures, mobile-device display). Sync "across all your devices" never names a desktop client, and the PAM module is a server-side login component, not a desktop code or vault app.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
